rows.text: The key to piloting Tidus, Yuna's Guardian is understanding its core engine: Tidus shifts counters between creatures at combat, and whenever creatures with counters deal combat damage, he draws a card and proliferates, rapidly compounding +1/+1 counters and loyalty across all permanents.

This is a Bracket 3 build running three Game Changers: Rhystic Study, Cyclonic Rift, Teferi's Protection. It contains zero mass land denial and focuses on high-synergy board development, interactive answers, and an inevitable endgame clock.
